subject: Manager conversation calibration + performance conversation training
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Manager conversation calibration + performance conversation training

Team —

Following the org changes we rolled out last week, I'd like to coordinate a short, practical training for managers on two things: calibration for quarterly performance reviews and running difficult one-on-one conversations (coaching, feedback, managing underperformance). Goal is to give new and seasoned managers a shared framework and a couple of role-play drills so we avoid inconsistent standards in Q2 reviews.

Asks:
- Can Steph pull any previous materials we used (playbooks, example conversation scripts)?
- David / Marissa — can you share two real scenarios (an underperformance case & a growth-oriented coaching case) that we could use in role-plays? Please redact personal identifiers.
- I want an external facilitator for a 90-min workshop (brief lecture + breakout role-plays + calibration exercise). If we go external, we should have cost/contract and a draft agenda before approving.

Timing: target week of Apr 12 so managers have time before review calibration in May.

I can loop in PeopleOps vendor partners if we want a polished facilitation + materials. Thoughts?

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
[attachment: roleplay-scenarios.docx]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Manager conversation calibration + performance conversation training

+1 on vendor facilitation. I pulled the old "difficult-convos" slide set from last year's leadership dev and updated it with notes from L&D. Attaching a short proposal from HRPartners — they do a good hybrid session and have a ready set of role-play scenarios tailored for SaaS managers.

Quick notes:
- Proposal price = $4,500 for up to 25 attendees (90 minutes).
- They suggested pre-work (15-minute self-assessment) and a 1-page manager cheat sheet after the session.
- They can run breakout role-plays in pairs and then we do a 20-minute cross-team calibration using a rubric.

Attaching their proposal and a draft scenarios doc. If we like this, I can ask them for a sample rubric and a DocuSign quote.

Cheers,
Steph
Stephanie Nguyen

Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Manager conversation calibration + performance conversation training

Thanks — I attached two short redacted scenarios below inline. Happy to present them during the workshop.

1) Underperformance: IC on Core Infra team has missed SLA targets for three consecutive sprints. Manager has coached twice but outcomes didn't improve; IC attributes it to ambiguous priorities and workload.

2) Growth coaching: Mid-level PM who needs to develop stakeholder influence; product deliveries are solid but cross-team escalation happens when dependencies aren't surfaced early.

Both are common across teams; would be good to have the rubric show how we weight impact vs. cadence vs. managerial supports.

I can also help run a short calibration exercise if we use real examples.

-David
David Kim
Principal Engineer (Manager)
Redwood Inference
